title: ai-pricing published prices, schema_version 2
description: Generated from scripts/pricing_validate.py, which remains the authority -- do not edit this file by hand. It describes one document, so two rules this repository enforces are necessarily absent: a figure may not move by more than a factor of 5 from the previous published file; and a block's currency must match the mapping its scraper reads. Validating against this schema proves the shape, the units and the plausible range of every figure. It does not prove the file is sane.

schema_version.description: A consumer that does not recognise this number must ignore the file and fall back, rather than misread it.

providers.description: Keyed by provider id. Never flatten this: the same model name at two providers is two different prices, not a collision to resolve.

checked_utc.description: When this provider's figures were last VERIFIED, changed or not.

updated.description: When this provider's figures last actually CHANGED.

source.description: The page these numbers came from. Always present.

sources.description: Present only where a block is built from more than one page: the full list, in the order read, always containing `source`.

currency.description: Never assume it, and never assume it matches another provider's. Nothing in this repository performs conversion.

models.description: Keyed by whatever identifies the entry at that source.

display_name.description: A human-readable label, kept so a diff is readable. Never match on it.

free.description: Present, and only ever true, when the provider gives this away. The entry then carries no price field at all -- never a price of 0.

kind.description: Absent means "model". "product" is a billable thing that is not a model and has no API model id.

absent_since.description: The day the source was first seen no longer offering this. Every price beside it is the last one observed, not a current one. Dropped after 365 days.

unpriced_since.description: The day the source was first seen offering this, still calling it paid, and stating no usable price. It may carry the last prices observed, or none at all. A consumer must not quote a price for such an entry.

disputed_since.description: The day the source was first seen listing this model more than once, with different prices. Every price beside it is the last one published before that, not a current one, until a human picks the real entry.

api_ids.description: The strings to pass AS THE MODEL when calling that provider, most specific first. A model identifier, never a URL: this file publishes no endpoints.

batch_derived.description: Present when the '_batch' fields beside it were WORKED OUT from a rule the source states in words, not read off the source as figures. Names the rule and the rate it was applied at. Absent -- the common case -- means every '_batch' figure was read as the provider stated it, so a consumer can tell the two kinds of claim apart.

long_context_threshold.description: The prompt size, in tokens, from which every token of a request is billed at the '_long_context' prices beside it instead of the plain ones.

in_per_mtok.description: Price in the block's currency, per the unit named by the key. A figure outside [0.001, 1000] normally means a page changed shape and the wrong number was read, not that the price moved.

then.description: Free and priced at once is a contradiction, and so is free and unpriced_since: a source cannot both give this away and decline to say what it costs.

else.description: An entry that is not free states a price, or says with unpriced_since why it cannot.

then.description: batch_derived explains a derived '_batch' figure, so an entry carrying it carries at least one.
A threshold with nothing billed past it says nothing, so an entry carrying one carries at least one '_long_context' price.
